BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to creating the medical professions account;amending RCW 18.71.401; and adding a new section to chapter 18.71 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 18.71 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The medical professions account is created in the custody of thestate treasurer. Expenditures from the account may only be used forthe administration and implementation of this chapter. Only thecommission or the executive director set forth in RCW 18.71.0191 mayauthorize expenditures from the account. No appropriation is requiredfor expenditures from this account. All fees, assessments, fines, andother funds of the commission currently deposited in the healthprofessions account must be transferred to the medical professionsaccount as soon as possible, but under no circumstances longer thanthirty days, after the effective date of this section.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 18.71.401 and 1997 c 79 s 1 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: All fees, assessments, fines, and other funds collected or received p. 1 HB 2894under this chapter must be deposited in the ((health)) medicalprofessions account and used solely to administer and implement thischapter.
